text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] SLO burn detected — p99 latency for /v1/generate (hosted) > 2000ms over last 5m (SLO burn: 18%). Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/d/latency-hosted

pagerduty: Page fired -> Oncall (maria). Priority: P1. Escalation path enabled.

maria: ack. I'm on it, starting triage. Any deploys in last 15m? :eyes:

zach: no code deploys in last 30m. Infra: queuing depth on inference-worker-*-pool spiked. saw queue_length -> 18k.

anya: digging into cache metrics — KV cache miss rate jumped from 2% -> 12% across the pool. Redis latency also climbed (50ms -> 220ms). Possible cache hotkey churn.

maria: good catch. If redis is the choke, let's fail open to bypass prefix cache for now. Can someone run the hotfix toggle?

zach: running toggle now. command: ``infractl feature-toggle set inference.prefix_cache.enabled false --env hosted --reason "p99 latency autopage"``

incident-bot: feature-toggle change detected by zach at 1778205620. service reload starting.

maria: rolling temporary routing policy to send traffic to fallback-model-1 for long-tail requests. This reduces per-request KV probe frequency.

leo: notifying support + status page. Drafting customer note: "We're investigating increased latency on generation endpoints; short term mitigations in progress." Will post in 5.

zach: redis P95 is back down to ~80ms after toggle and partial fail-open. queue_length trending down to 4.2k.

anya: observed a secondary effect: batching batch-size auto-grow when latencies spike, compounding tail. Putting a cap on max_batch_size to 12. command: ``kubectl -n inference patch deploy inference-router -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"router","env":[{"name":"MAX_BATCH_SIZE","value":"12"}]}]}}}}'``

maria: confirming mitigations: 1) prefix_cache fail-open, 2) cap batch size, 3) route long tail to fallback-model-1. Early signal: p99 down from ~2.3s -> ~1.1s in last 2m. still above target but trending. :thumbsup:

pagerduty: Acknowledgement recorded (maria). Next escalation window at +10m if no improvement.

leo: support update posted to customers affected list. tagging top customers.

anya: logs show a recurring pattern: certain prompt prefixes causing cache churn (high cardinality). Suggest we add prefix hashing guard in Optimize to prevent cache key explosion. I'll open a follow-up PR once stabilized.

maria: creating incident doc: https://confluence.redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-045. Summary for handoff: current mitigations active, p99 trending down but not yet within SLO. No rollback needed at this time.

zach: starting autoscale surge: ``rdctl scale inference-hosted --pool main --add 6`` — adding capacity to handle backlog. ETA ~90s for new nodes.

maria: if anyone needs to step off before resolution, handoff to next oncall (zach) at 1778205800. I'll do a quick runbook transfer in 5m.

zach: ack, will take primary after handoff. current action items I own: monitor queue drain, confirm no replica churn, track p99 to <700ms.

maria: impact assessment for postmortem: customer-visible latency increase (~p95 normal, p99 spike). Estimated affected traffic: ~2.1% of hosted requests over 10m window. No error-rate increase observed, primarily slow responses.

leo: logging follow-up: add alert to catch KV miss-rate >10% for >3m to avoid surprise burn.

incident-bot: Page acknowledged by maria at 1778205565. Escalation suspended.

maria: handing off now — zach (oncall) will continue mitigation and coordinate with infra to revert temporary toggles once all cleared. Leaving notes in incident doc. :white_check_mark:

zach: taking over. will update thread every 5m or on status change.

maria: thanks team. I'll be reachable if anything flips.
